title: Sangria and spritz workshop in Seville
text: There was a group of nine of us and three others and it was a lovely experience. We met some lovely people and even ended up going out with them for some more drinks after. The space was set up very nicely, very welcoming and clean. I liked that there was a curtain where the kitchen was so when the guide came out with the tapas it was an element of surprise! The guide was lovely and was very patient and answered any questions we had. It was nice that during the making he left us to it so we felt comfortable to mingle with the other people there. The food was lovely too!
author: Z8385TCemmar

title: We were able to experiment and make our own drinks!
text: A really fun and interactive experience! The cocktails were delicious, the instructor was friendly and engaging, and the tapas were a great addition. It was a perfect way to spend an evening and learn something new.
author: paucxmbil

title: Such a blast
text: This was by far my favorite part of our trip to Seville. It was a group of 4 of us and we learned so much from our host Antonio. It was a fun interactive workshop, so it's very hands on with you making your own drinks while enjoying tapas.
author: sophiakD7446ZH
